description: Canonical track-id registry. Maps any user-provided alias (case-insensitive) to a canonical_id. Used by gt_loader to resolve gt_*.geojson filenames and by build_track_surface to thread track identity into boundary estimation. Add a track here before adding it to the corpus; reject ambiguous aliases at PR review.

ok.notes: V1 launch track. gt traced 2026-04-11 via Theo's custom tool: gt_circuit-d-essay.geojson (163 left + 160 right pts). File's internal track_id is 'kart_essay'; aliases cover both that and the filename slug 'circuit-d-essay' so load_gt('ok') finds it via the alias probe.

kct.notes: Day 5 primary validation target. gt: 60 left + 93 right pts. Day 4b empirical baseline gap = 3.36m mean against data_derived boundaries.

jv.notes: Day 5 secondary validation target (gt + CSV both present).

slk.notes: gt filename is gt_slk-fp1.geojson (variant suffix); session CSVs are SLK_FP*.csv. Registry resolves both to slk.

auxois-sud.notes: gt exists, no production CSV. Deferred.
